name: Rest Day Nutrition
purpose: Support recovery and appetite control without overfeeding carbs.
protein_target_rule: 2.0 g/kg bodyweight minimum split across 3-4 feedings.
hydration_target_rule: 35-40 ml/kg baseline fluids + electrolytes with one meal.
example_meals: Chicken rice bowl with roasted veg
healthy_cheat_feel_meals: High-protein burger bowl and oven fries
Loaded potato with lean beef and cheese
avoid_if: All-day fasting before hard next day
notes_for_athlete: Use structure to prevent discipline eating drift.
Pre-log dinner to reduce random snacking.

name: One Session Day
purpose: Fuel one quality training session while maintaining bodyweight control.
example_meals: Post-session rice bowl with lean beef
notes_for_athlete: Keep tasty options ready to prevent takeaway slip-ups.

name: Two Session Day
purpose: Support two training exposures with strategic carb distribution and recovery.
healthy_cheat_feel_meals: Frozen yogurt protein bowl with cereal crunch
avoid_if: High-fat heavy lunch before PM work
notes_for_athlete: Two sessions need planned snacks; do not rely on willpower.

name: Technical Day Food
purpose: Support sharpness and movement quality without heavy gut load.
hydration_target_rule: 35-45 ml/kg; include sodium at one meal.
meal_timing_rules: Avoid very heavy greasy pre-session meal
healthy_cheat_feel_meals: Crunchy chicken wrap with light sauce
notes_for_athlete: Stay loose by avoiding stomach-heavy food before training.

name: Explosive Day Food
purpose: Fuel CNS-demanding speed and power work.
avoid_if: Training fasted when power is priority
notes_for_athlete: Power sessions need reliable carbs; don't wing it.

name: Conditioning Day Food
purpose: Support repeat effort while controlling fatigue and recovery.
notes_for_athlete: Conditioning output drops when carbs are too low.

name: Sparring Day Food
purpose: Maintain decision speed and resilience during high-demand ring work.
healthy_cheat_feel_meals: Lean beef burger and potato wedges
notes_for_athlete: Protect reaction speed with hydration and carbs.

name: Fight Week Day Food
purpose: Keep weight trending safely while preserving sharpness and recovery.
hydration_target_rule: Maintain consistent hydration; no aggressive dehydration.
meal_timing_rules: Lower-residue choices if gut comfort needed
notes_for_athlete: Conservative, repeatable strategy only in fight week.

name: Weigh-In Day Food
purpose: Safely make weight with conservative approach and GI comfort.
protein_target_rule: Keep protein moderate in small feedings.
hydration_target_rule: Follow coach/medical guidance; avoid extreme unsafe dehydration.
avoid_if: Laxatives or diuretics without medical supervision
notes_for_athlete: Safety first; no aggressive cut hacks.

name: Post Weigh-In Refeed
purpose: Restore fluid, glycogen, and gut comfort before competition.
protein_target_rule: Protein in each feeding, moderate portions.
hydration_target_rule: Begin with electrolyte fluids then regular water; sip steadily.
notes_for_athlete: Refuel in phases, not one giant binge.

name: Post Fight Recovery Nutrition
purpose: Rebuild recovery while preventing post-fight overeating chaos.
hydration_target_rule: Return to normal hydration rhythm with electrolytes.
healthy_cheat_feel_meals: Protein burger night with baked fries
notes_for_athlete: Enjoy food but keep structure to stabilize weight rebound.
